name: lens
description: A reading lens for AI-generated code: statically folds review-irrelevant regions (imports, doc comments, guards, logging, defensive boilerplate)

scripts.install-skill: mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && for s in skills/*/; do n=$(basename "$s"); ln -sfn "$PWD/skills/$n" ~/.claude/skills/$n && echo "linked ~/.claude/skills/$n → $PWD/skills/$n"; done
scripts.uninstall-skill: for s in skills/*/; do n=$(basename "$s"); t=~/.claude/skills/$n; if [ -L "$t" ] && [ "$(readlink "$t")" = "$PWD/skills/$n" ]; then rm "$t" && echo "removed $t"; elif [ -e "$t" ]; then echo "left $t alone (not a link to this repo)"; else echo "not installed: $n"; fi; done
